$comment: Phase 1 default configuration. Every stochastic choice in the factory is derived from `seed`; nothing here may depend on wall-clock time, environment, or thread scheduling. REVISION 1: removed a duplicated `$comment` key inside `generation` (the second silently overwrote the first).

expansion.$comment_axes: REVISION 1: irrelevant_axes are observation-surface paths ONLY (matching the world-spec pattern ^observation\.(request|rendering)\..*). 'display_name.case' was removed because display_name is an entity field, so perturbing it changed world state and made Gate 6 unsatisfiable; it is now the render-time-only axis 'observation.rendering.display_name_case'. compile_spec asserts set(critical_state_variables) matches this whitelist and that no critical axis is an observation path. REVISION 1.5 (provider smoke): added 'resource.*.state' — resource_state is one of the 20 invariant categories (order paid vs refunded decides refund verdicts), so resource state is a legitimate critical axis; the first real batches lost worlds to this omission. REVISION 1.6 (provider smoke round 2): added 'session.*.principal' (cross-account session misuse is the session_binding/cross_user_isolation failure mode) and 'token.*.one_time' (one-time token reuse is its own invariant category); both were lost to whitelist omissions in real batches.

level_to_hidden_set.$comment: REVISION 1: the level -> hidden-set mapping is now explicit, so test_masking_levels.py has a deterministic target. H(f) = the set of VISIBLE evidence items asserting fact f.
level_to_hidden_set.complete: every evidence item with visible_in_observation=true is rendered
level_to_hidden_set.partially_missing: >=1 non-consulted evidence item is hidden; every consulted fact keeps >=1 visible establishing item
level_to_hidden_set.minimally_sufficient: every consulted fact keeps exactly one visible establishing item; all others hidden
level_to_hidden_set.contradictory: >=1 consulted fact has >=2 visible items with different values, at least one of them establishing
level_to_hidden_set.stale: >=1 consulted fact's only visible establishing item has freshness in {stale, expired} and an in-scope policy has requires_fresh=true
level_to_hidden_set.attacker_controlled: >=1 consulted fact's only visible items have attacker_controllable=true and none is in trusted_establishes

attack_requires.$comment: REVISION 1: the world_truth aggregation rule, made independent of author input. A default-deny hit alone yields 'unauthorized', never 'attack'.

group_key_purposes.$comment: REVISION 2 (task A7): every group key and its purpose, including the four new keys. The eight leave-key-out strategies hold out exactly one key each (strategy_to_group_key above); the new keys are additional grouping dimensions that tighten union-find components and give the audit family-level views. generator_model_family is deliberately NOT a ninth strategy in Phase 1: adding strategies would change episode.split_assignments' eight-row contract (G8 asserts exactly eight rows), so it is an audit/aggregation dimension now and a candidate strategy when a second generator family actually exists.
group_key_purposes.counterfactual_family_id: iid holdout: same counterfactual family must share one split (I-3).
group_key_purposes.world_family_id: world_ood holdout: same world structure (identifier-abstracted) must share one split.
group_key_purposes.app_domain: app_ood holdout: unseen application domains go to test.
group_key_purposes.workflow_template_hash: workflow_ood holdout: unseen workflow state-machine shapes go to test.
group_key_purposes.policy_graph_hash: policy_ood holdout: unseen policy graphs go to test.
group_key_purposes.attack_family: attack_ood holdout: unseen attack families go to test.
group_key_purposes.semantic_scenario_signature: evidence_ood holdout: unseen scenario shapes go to test.
group_key_purposes.generator_id: generator_ood holdout: unseen generator (model@version) goes to test.
group_key_purposes.generator_model_family: REVISION 2: generator model FAMILY (provider/家族名, e.g. 'deepseek' from 'deepseek-v4-flash@2026-08-01'). Aggregates generator_id across versions so an audit can ask 'does this whole generator family leak?' instead of 'does this exact version leak?'. Degenerate (single value 'handcrafted') on the handcrafted corpus - dropped from union-find with an explicit warning, never silently merged.
group_key_purposes.policy_family_id: REVISION 2: 'PF-' + policy_graph_hash[:12] - the short, human-readable form of the policy-graph dimension. Strictly 1:1 with policy_graph_hash, so it tightens nothing on its own; it exists so manifests and reviews can name a policy family without pasting 64 hex chars.
group_key_purposes.workflow_family_id: REVISION 2: 'WFF-' + workflow_template_hash[:12] - short form of the workflow-template dimension, 1:1 with workflow_template_hash.
group_key_purposes.invariant_family_id: REVISION 2: 'IF-' + sha256(invariant-set skeleton)[:12] - a NEW dimension (no hash twin): two worlds whose invariant sets abstract to the same shape share a family, so 'same invariants, different entities' worlds cannot straddle a split via a dimension nobody was watching.

family_scoped_dedup.$comment: REVISION 1: exact dedup runs WITHIN a counterfactual family, never across families. Header-order and other irrelevant perturbations legitimately produce distinct bytes inside a family and must not be folded away; cross-family byte equality is what dedup is for.

semantic_similarity.$comment: NOT IMPLEMENTED in Phase 1. Enabled only after the embedding backend is chosen; it must never silently relax the exact/normalized/structural gates.

G6_semantics.$comment: REVISION 1: G6 is explicitly a MECHANICAL diff check (diff_worlds(base, variant).changed_paths == ()), which cannot fail by construction. The informative check - that no label-correlated noise entered the rendered surface - is G11 and is a hard gate.

G11_surface_label_independence.$comment_scale: REVISION 3 (21-world deep review P1-7): min_samples 200 -> 64. 200 was calibrated for the full handcrafted corpus (373 episodes in one renderer); the first real provider run produced 104 episodes (8 accepted worlds x ~13 variants), so at milestone-1 scale the gate never ran - and 'never ran' must not be reported as 'passed' (the honest fallback, kept) nor as 'failed'. 64 is the scale-equivalent floor: 8 worlds x 8 episodes, i.e. the smallest milestone batch that still gives the Miller-Madow-corrected estimator enough samples to separate a real surface leak from small-sample bias, while staying far below the point where one family's knob features could dominate the estimate. The threshold is a SAMPLE-FLOOR, not a tolerance: below it the gate reports checked=False ('samples N < min_samples M, G11 did not run'), never a pass. Revisit when the corpus passes ~600 episodes in one renderer.

G12_lexical_label_leakage.$comment: REVISION 2 (task A1): the lexical twin of G11. G11 is statistical (mutual information); G12 is deterministic - if a verdict-revealing word appears anywhere in observation.model_visible (including request.rendered_text), a model can solve the sample by string matching instead of security reasoning. decision_metadata is exempt (those words belong to the oracle/gate side; the model-visible boundary is enforced separately by conftest.model_visible_boundary and G2). No min_samples: a single leaked sample is enough to matter. REVISION 3 (21-world deep review P0-2): matching is now per IDENTIFIER SEGMENT (split on -._/@, exact segment match) instead of 'word not glued to .@_'. The old rule let the answer through as ACT-L2-ATTACKER, SES-L2-ATTACK.valid and 'Compromised CI service session starts.' (104 episodes, 0 hits). attacker/attacks/compromised join the list for the same reason: an entity id or event summary that names the attacker IS the label. The reserved-domain exemption (RFC 2606 *.example.invalid host slugs and act-001@example.invalid mailboxes, which the whole synthetic corpus uses) is explicit and bounded - see security_world/validation/lexical.py; it is NOT a narrowing of the vocabulary.

generation.$comment: Phase 1: provider is ALWAYS 'replay' (recorded fixture). A live provider is a Phase 2 capability requiring explicit opt-in plus an audit record; no network call may ever be made by a test.
generation.$comment_scale: 500-world capability is built in Phase 1 but NOT executed at scale; scale runs are a separate, separately-budgeted activity.

projection_allowlist.$comment: REVISION 1: an explicit per-renderer allowlist. A renderer may project only entity/state fields; it may NEVER project world.metadata (removed from the schema entirely), provenance, seed, policies, invariants, hypotheses, or any oracle output. Enforced by test_renderer_projection_allowlist.

gate2_invariants.$comment: REVISION 1: Gate 2 checks that JSON Schema cannot express.
